svg.text: Raw previous-turn feedback: path tracking by fixed field
sCurve, seed 19 · same start, route, duration, and controls
3 s controlled fixture (180 ticks at 60 Hz), not natural trajectories. Colored paths show position; turn persistence alone does not establish route tracking.
Both panels use shared world limits x = 0.30–0.72, y = 0.45–0.72 and equal x/y scale.
